queue.noDoctorProfile: Your account is not linked to a doctor profile. Ask an administrator to set one up.
queue.columnEmpty: Nobody waiting — free to take the next patient.
queue.boardSummary: {waiting, plural, =0 {Nobody waiting} =1 {1 patient waiting} other {# patients waiting}} across {doctors, plural, =1 {1 doctor} other {# doctors}}
queue.noDoctorsHint: Ask an administrator to add doctor profiles.
queue.moveNewToken: The patient gets a new token number in the other doctor's queue. Tell them the new number.
queue.nowhereToMove: There is no other doctor to move this patient to.
queue.dragHint: Drag the handle to change who is seen first.

consultation.title: Consultation
consultation.noteRequired: Write a note before completing the visit.
consultation.reviewInVisit: Patient waits and comes back to me
consultation.reviewInVisitHint: Otherwise the visit moves to the counter for clearance.
consultation.startPrompt: Start the consultation to record anything.
consultation.notMyPatient: This visit is assigned to another doctor.

home.noHome: There is nothing assigned to your role yet.
home.noHomeHint: Ask an administrator to check your roles.

errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to open this.

vitals.title: Record vitals
vitals.savedAbnormal: Vitals recorded — one or more are outside the normal range.
vitals.bloodPressurePair: Record both blood pressure values, or neither.
vitals.diastolicBelowSystolic: Diastolic must be below systolic. Check the two are not swapped.
vitals.pulseRange: Pulse must be between 0 and 400 bpm.
vitals.systolicRange: Systolic must be between 0 and 400 mmHg.
vitals.diastolicRange: Diastolic must be between 0 and 300 mmHg.
vitals.respiratoryRateRange: Respiratory rate must be between 0 and 150 /min.
vitals.weightRange: Weight must be between 0 and 700 kg.
vitals.glucoseRange: Glucose must be between 0 and 2000 mg/dL.

lab.title: Diagnostics bench
lab.subtitle: Every open lab and radiology request, in the order to work them.
lab.emptyHint: Requests appear here as doctors order them.
lab.emptyCatalogue: No investigations are set up for this discipline yet.
lab.noAnalytes: This investigation has no analytes configured.
lab.verifyHint: Signing off releases the report to the clinician and clears the doctor's order. It cannot be edited afterwards — a correction becomes an amendment.
lab.patientDeceased: This patient is recorded as deceased.

billing.boardSubtitle: Visits with money outstanding, longest waiting first.
billing.boardEmptyHint: Visits appear here as charges are captured.
billing.unpricedWarning: Something on this visit has no price set
billing.deceasedSettlement: This patient has died. The bill is still to be settled — speak to the family, and record who paid.
billing.noPendingCharges: Every charge is on an invoice.
billing.needsIssuing: This draft has to be issued before payment can be taken.
billing.referenceHint: Needed to reconcile against tomorrow's settlement file.
billing.payerNamePlaceholder: Name of the relative settling the bill

patients.title: Patients
patients.subtitle: Everyone registered here, most recent first.
patients.emptyHint: They appear here as reception registers them.
patients.name: Name

admin.title: Administration
admin.subtitle: Everything the hospital configures for itself. Until these screens existed, all of it required running a script against the database.
admin.name: Name
admin.staffCard: Create accounts and decide what each person may do.
admin.doctorsCard: Clinic profiles. Without one, a doctor cannot be picked at the counter.
admin.departmentsCard: The units doctors, wards and services belong to.
admin.servicesCard: Rate cards and what each service costs. Without a price, nothing is billed.
admin.catalogueCard: The investigations that can be ordered, and their reference ranges.
admin.wardsCard: Where inpatients are admitted. No beds means no admissions.
admin.staffDescription: Accounts are deactivated, never deleted — an account that saw a patient is part of the audit trail.
admin.addStaffHint: The password you set here is temporary; they replace it at first sign-in.
admin.staffEmptyHint: Try clearing the search, or add the first account.
admin.atLeastOneRole: An account with no roles can sign in and do nothing. Deactivate it instead.
admin.temporaryPasswordHint: At least 12 characters. They will be asked to change it at first sign-in.
admin.doctorsDescription: A doctor is two records: an account that can sign in, and a profile that can hold a clinic. Both are needed before reception can send anyone to them.
admin.addDoctorHint: Pick the staff account this clinic profile belongs to.
admin.doctorsEmptyHint: Reception cannot send a patient to anybody until one exists.
admin.doctorsWithoutProfile: {count} staff account(s) hold the doctor role but have no clinic profile, so they cannot be picked at the counter.
admin.noDoctorCandidates: Every doctor account already has a profile.
admin.registrationNumberHint: Printed on lab reports they sign. A report without one is not valid.
admin.departmentsDescription: Doctors, wards and services all belong to a department. Those pickers stay empty until this list does not.
admin.addDepartmentHint: The code is uppercased and stored without spaces.
admin.departmentsEmptyHint: Add the first one — most other setup refers to it.
admin.servicesDescription: Billing never refuses a charge for missing configuration — an unpriced service is captured at zero and flagged. That means a hospital with no price list bills nobody and still looks like it is working.
admin.addServiceHint: What the hospital charges for. GST applies to diagnostics, pharmacy and rooms.
admin.addRateCardHint: A price list for one kind of payer — cash, an insurer, or a scheme.
admin.servicesEmptyHint: Nothing can be billed until at least the consultation fee exists.
admin.noRateCards: There is no rate card at all, so every charge will be captured at zero.
admin.noDefaultRateCard: No rate card is marked default. A walk-in cash patient has no price list to fall back on.
admin.unpricedServices: {count} service(s) have no price on this card.
admin.gstRateRequired: A taxable service needs a rate above zero.
admin.makeDefaultHint: What a walk-in cash patient is priced against.
admin.catalogueDescription: The investigations a doctor can order. A test with no analytes can be ordered and accessioned, and then there is nothing for the technician to type into.
admin.addTestHint: A laboratory test needs a specimen type; a radiology study must not have one.
admin.catalogueEmptyHint: Nothing can be accessioned at the bench until one exists.
admin.rangeInvalid: The lower bound must be below the upper one.
admin.appliesToHint: Haemoglobin and several others genuinely differ by sex.
admin.wardsDescription: Setting up the physical wards and beds. The nursing station's bed board is a different screen and comes with the rest of inpatient care.
admin.addWardHint: A ward's class sets the default for every bed in it.
admin.wardsEmptyHint: A patient cannot be admitted until there is somewhere to admit them.
admin.bedsEmptyHint: Add a numbered run of them.
admin.bedsRangeInvalid: Give a range of 1 to 100 beds.
admin.bedPrefixHint: A bed code is unique across the whole hospital, so it carries the ward code.
admin.templatesCard: The wording of every SMS, WhatsApp and email the system sends.
admin.templatesDescription: Every message has shipped English wording as a fallback. Write a template to override it, or to add a language.
admin.templatesEmptyHint: Messages still go out — in the shipped English wording. Add a template to change it or to write one in another language.
admin.subject: Subject
admin.previewHint: Renders the saved wording with sample values. Nothing is sent.
admin.previewClean: Every placeholder in this wording will be filled.
admin.missingPlaceholders: Nothing fills these, so they are dropped and leave a gap in the message: {list}

wards.title: Bed board
wards.subtitle: Every ward, every bed, and who is in it.
wards.noWardsHint: An administrator adds wards and beds under Administration.
wards.reasonHint: A bed that disappears from the board with no reason is a bed nobody dares bring back.
wards.attendantHint: This is who the ward telephones at 3am.
wards.dischargeInitiatedHint: The doctor has written the discharge. The bed stays theirs until the patient actually leaves — settling the bill and collecting medicines takes time, and a bed freed at the signature is a bed that gets double-booked.
wards.transferHint: Moving the patient releases the old bed for cleaning.
wards.discharged: Patient discharged. The bed is now being turned around.
wards.terminalOutcomesHint: A death or a discharge against medical advice is recorded against the visit, not here — that path captures who certified it and why, and this admission follows automatically.

chart.title: Medication chart
chart.roundSubtitle: Every dose due across the wards, oldest first.
chart.roundClearHint: Doses appear here as they fall due.
chart.noDosesHint: They appear once a drug is prescribed.
chart.reasonHint: A blank reason on a missed antibiotic is the gap an incident review cannot close.
chart.prescribeHint: Scheduled drugs generate dose slots automatically.
chart.asNeededHint: No fixed times; a nurse records it when it is given.
chart.drugScheduleHint: H, H1 and X need the prescription kept on file.
chart.stopReasonHint: A drug that vanishes with no explanation is one a covering doctor restarts.

summary.title: Discharge summary
summary.notCompiled: No summary has been compiled yet.
summary.notCompiledHint: It is assembled from what was already recorded during the stay — diagnoses, course, investigations, drugs — so nobody types it from memory.
summary.signHint: Signing freezes the document. A correction afterwards is an amendment, which leaves both versions.
summary.frozenHint: This summary is signed. It can no longer be edited — a correction is an amendment.
summary.diagnosisRequired: A diagnosis is needed before this can be signed — a discharge document that does not say what was wrong is not a document.

reports.title: Reports
reports.subtitle: How the hospital is running, from what was already recorded.
reports.todaySubtitle: The live queue, updating on its own.
reports.occupancySubtitle: Occupancy right now, not an average over the window.
reports.autoClosed: {count} visits were closed by the nightly sweep rather than by a person. Every one is a visit somebody forgot to complete.
reports.inpatientSubtitle: Admissions, length of stay and how stays ended.
reports.noDischarges: Nobody was discharged in this window.
reports.followUpSubtitle: Whether patients advised to come back actually did.
reports.complianceHint: Of those whose follow-up date has passed
reports.revenueSubtitle: Three separate numbers. They are not meant to be added together.
reports.unpricedCharges: {count} charges were captured with no price. Each is an act the hospital has not decided how to bill for.
reports.noCharges: Nothing was charged in this window.
reports.noPayments: Nothing was collected in this window.

messages.title: Messages
messages.subtitle: What the system sent, what it could not, and what it chose not to.
messages.noAttemptsSuppressed: Nothing was tried. This message was deliberately not sent.
messages.cancelReasonHint: A message withdrawn with no explanation is one the next person re-sends.
messages.blockedSubtitle: Who the system will not message, and why.
messages.liftReasonHint: Re-enabling messaging to somebody who opted out is a consent decision. It has to say who decided, and why.
messages.deathNotLiftable: A death suppression is never released. The rule is in the service, not in permissions, so it cannot be granted back.
messages.deathNotTypedIn: A death is recorded by the clinical death entry, never typed in here.
messages.messagingOn: This patient is being messaged normally.

outcome.title: How did this visit end?
outcome.irreversible: This closes the visit permanently. Nothing reopens it — a correction is a new visit, which leaves both on the record.
outcome.certifiedByHint: The doctor who certified the death, not whoever is entering it.
outcome.referralReasonHint: The receiving hospital reads this before the patient arrives.
outcome.formSignedHint: Recorded either way. An unsigned form is the hospital's exposure, and pretending otherwise helps nobody.

card.title: Patient card
card.bringThis: Bring this card to every visit.
card.printHint: Print on card stock if you have it. The code must stay at least 20 mm across to scan reliably.

admissions.title: Admission desk
admissions.subtitle: Patients sent from OPD for admission. Admit gives them a bed and starts their inpatient stay.
admissions.waitingTitle: {count, plural, =0 {Nobody waiting} =1 {1 patient waiting} other {# patients waiting}}
admissions.empty: Nobody is waiting to be admitted.
admissions.emptyHint: Patients appear here when reception sends them for admission.
admissions.sendHint: The admission desk will choose a bed and admit the patient.
